cs.t: A massage gun. I got something called the LifePro Sonic Pro X or something like that, but it looks like the same gun is sold under different brands. I have back issues (muscular, not skeletal thank god) and combined with a sitting-heavy job I can get really tight and wound up in a way that fucks up my posture, my walking gait, and my ability to get a good workout in at the end of the day. The massage gun reallly lets you loosen up and focus on areas that are tough to stretch, and it’s a lot gentler and less stressful than stretching. It has made a huge difference for me, all over my body. I massage gun while docker builds or CI tests are running, when my mic and camera are off during a meeting, etc. Great stuff.
